about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in Godstone Tactics, a turn-based strategy game that combines tactical depth with competitive excitement. Lead your team of adorable yet fierce animal units into battle. Navigate a variety of unique and challenging arenas, each presenting its own obstacles to overcome. Outsmart your opponents, safeguard your King, and pursue victory in the mystical realm of Sangreal!

As Sangreal descends into chaos, Savroth seeks a worthy ruler. Countless battles erupt with a single goal: to crown the true King. Who knows, p that King is you!

  • Different Arenas Each arena features varied terrains and challenges, including treacherous ice fields and petrifying fireflies. Adapt your strategies to dominate every arena.

  • Setting Your Team Strategically place your animal units on your side. Each unit has distinct roles and movement patterns, making placement essential for victory.

  • Strategic Depth and Competitive Play Engage in tactical battles where every move is pivotal. Protect your King, eliminate your opponent’s, and compete in ranked matches to climb the leaderboards.

• Competitive Play: Compete in ranked matches to earn royal points and rise in the leaderboards.
• Immersive Pixel Art: Enjoy vibrant pixel art that brings Sangreal’s world to life.

• Various Play Modes: Play ranked battles, solo training, puzzles or casual matchs.

• Daily Puzzles: Solve daily challenges to earn rewards and enhance your tactics.

• Different arenas: Battle on varied terrains, each with unique gameplay effects.

• Set Your Team: Choose your animal units from your unit pool each game, focusing on strategic placement.

• Discover Sangreal: Explore the rich lore and stories behind each unit and arena.

• Cross-Platform Coming Soon: Play “Godstone Tactics” on PC (Steam) and mobile devices (Android, iOS).

Beyond the tactical arenas, Sangreal offers a wealth of adventures, locales, and animal heroes waiting to be discovered. As developers, we are excited to share our first indie game, "Godstone Tactics," and can't wait to hear your thoughts and experiences in this immersive world.

short_description: Godstone Tactics is a tactical turn-based strategy game featuring competitive battles. Assemble your team of distinctive animal units. Master the unique challenges of each isometric arena with your tactics. Outsmart opponents to defeat the enemy king and claim victory in the world of Sangreal!
